criteria.title: Complete checkpoint and excluded-tensor integrity
criteria.description: Every source checkpoint row appears once with its original shape, and tensors marked ineligible are preserved exactly.

criteria.title: Correct activation-aware 2:4 pruning
criteria.description: Eligible rows keep the two greatest weight-times-aggregated-activation scores in each consecutive group of four, preserve retained source values, zero the rest, and honor deterministic ties.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.

criteria.title: Layer and validation summary reconciliation
criteria.description: The concise layer summaries and global validation metrics cover the full model and reconcile with the delivered checkpoint, sparsity pattern, calibration coverage, and exclusions.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
